responsibility: Implements lowering of top-level and module-level Rust items into HIR items. It converts AST modules, type aliases, structs, unions, enums, statics, constants, functions, traits, impl blocks, trait impls, and extern blocks, recursively invoking specialized lowerers for enum variants, impl items, trait items, expressions, statements, patterns, types, and where-clause entries. The file also performs item-level mapping registration, outer-attribute handling, visibility translation, and parent linkage for trait and impl members, making it the main dispatcher for item-oriented AST-to-HIR construction.
same_name_distinction: Provides the concrete item-lowering implementations that translate AST modules, aliases, structs, traits, impls, and extern blocks into HIR items and register them in mappings; rust-ast-lower-item.h is the declaration layer for the item and simple-path lowerers.
